noProject.title: Open a project
noProject.description: Claude Code works in a project's folder. Open or create a project first.

noFolder.title: The project has no folder
noFolder.description: Link a folder to the project so Claude Code can work with its files.

notFound.title: Claude Code was not found
notFound.description: Install the Claude Code extension (Extensions → anthropic.claude-code) or the claude CLI, or point Orkestr to the claude executable.

login.title: Sign in to Claude
login.description: Claude Code is installed but not signed in. Sign in once in a terminal; Orkestr never reads your credentials.
login.openedHint: A terminal with “claude auth login” is open. Finish the sign-in there, then press “Check again”.

welcome.title: Claude Code
welcome.description: Chat with Claude Code about this project: it reads and edits files and runs commands — with your permission.

history.title: Recent conversations
history.empty: No earlier conversations in this folder.

hint.default: Claude asks before editing files and running commands
hint.acceptEdits: File edits are accepted automatically; commands still ask
hint.plan: Claude only plans: no edits, no commands
hint.bypassPermissions: Nothing asks for permission — use only in a disposable environment

bypass.title: Turn off all confirmations?
bypass.body: In this mode Claude Code edits files and runs any command without asking, and Orkestr's checks of dangerous commands no longer apply.
bypass.note: This applies to this chat only and is never remembered. The conversation restarts with the new mode.

chat.label: Conversation with Claude Code
chat.empty: Ask anything about the project. Type @ to mention a file, / for commands.

composer.label: Message to Claude Code
composer.placeholderBusy: Claude is working — your message will be queued

permission.title: Claude wants to use {{tool}}
permission.allowSessionHint: Don't ask again for this kind of action until the chat ends

result.costHint: API-equivalent cost reported by Claude Code (a subscription is not charged per request)

errors.authRequired: Claude Code is not signed in.
